chunks: Friends will turn into enemies on that day, except those who fear and follow the straight path.

key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: On that day (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: Who remains friends on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Az-Zukhruf highlights the ultimate severance of worldly ties based on spiritual alignment, illustrating how shared history does not guarantee shared destiny. The exception of 'al-Muttaqin' underscores the centrality of Taqwa (God-consciousness) as the sole criterion for enduring unity, a concept deeply resonant with the Shia emphasis on the bond of the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful. This serves as a practical reminder that true companionship is rooted in piety rather than mere social proximity.
